name: Slip
intro: The maze exists in four dimensions. You see one slice of it at a time, one colour. Doors are open only in their own colour, and shards can only be grabbed in theirs. Press Q or E (or turn the controller like a dial) to slide through the fourth dimension. Collect both shards, then roll into the portal.
hint: Doors open only in their own colour. Q / E (or turn the controller) to phase.
